description: This file contains unit tests for the LDAPEmployeeSelectorMapping class in the LDAP DTO namespace. The tests verify creation from array, validation, and extraction of attribute values from LDAP entries, specifically for employee-related attributes.

classes.name: LDAPEmployeeSelectorMappingTest
classes.description: Unit test class for LDAPEmployeeSelectorMapping, extending TestCase to verify mapping creation, validation, and LDAP search parameter extraction.

methods.name: testCreateFromArray
methods.description: Tests successful creation of LDAPEmployeeSelectorMapping from an array and verifies correctness.

methods.name: testCreateFromArrayWithInvalidField
methods.description: Verifies that creating from an array with an invalid 'field' throws an InvalidArgumentException.

methods.name: testCreateFromArrayWithEmptyField
methods.description: Checks for exception when 'field' key is missing or empty in the input array.

methods.name: testCreateFromArrayWithEmptyAttributeName
methods.description: Checks for exception when 'attributeName' key is missing or invalid.

methods.name: testExtractAttributeValuesToSearchFilterParam
methods.description: Verifies correct extraction of attribute values from LDAP entries based on mapping.

methods.name: testExtractAttributeValuesToSearchFilterParamWithoutMapping
methods.description: Ensures method returns null when no mapping is provided.
